title: Shin Yoroiden Samurai Troopers
originalTitle: 新鎧伝サムライトルーパー
summary: An unfinished next-generation continuation set in 1992. Arago revives and is immediately taken away, Ashura seeks Kayura's help, and the Eight Holy Heaven Warriors target the Fire and Ice blades. New armor warriors Ryoga Takeda, Kai Iwami, and Saki Hyodo appear, with character designs by Norio Shioyama and armor designs by Hideo Okamoto. The reviewer laments that Tenku and Suiko never appear and treats the anime-continuity claim as difficult to reconcile with Message.
